description: As of October 21, 2026, ISC is affected by a vulnerability in the following products:
products:
BIND 9
	Versions 9.11.0 to 9.18.50
Versions 9.11.0 to 9.18.50
  Versions 9.21.0 to 9.21.26

BIND Supported Preview Edition
	Versions 9.11.3-S1 to 9.18.50-S1
Versions 9.20.9-S1 to 9.20.29-S1
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
